verdict.rationale: Ramp documents interest-bearing balances: a Checking Account at 2% APY and an Investment Account earning up to 4.46%. However, the evidence shows only US-based banking ("Banking is US-only"), and nothing shows balances held or earning interest in non-USD currencies. Currency codes such as EUR and JPY appear only for payments and stablecoin Bill Pay. missing for 10: multi-currency balance holding, interest or yield on non-USD balances, any independent corroboration of yield.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn interest on balances held in multiple currencies
